regions.today: A bright evening with sunny spells and some well scattered showers, in light to moderate westerly winds.
regions.tonight: Mostly dry tonight with clear spells and just isolated showers. It will become cloudier over the north of the province later. Lowest temperatures of 8 to 11 degrees in a light southwesterly breeze.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow, Saturday, will be dry with sunny spells, turning hazier in the afternoon. Highest temperatures of 18 to 22 degrees in a light westerly breeze.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate to high on Saturday. Low to moderate on Sunday.
